= Pressure Acoustics, Frequency Domain (acpr)
:page-toclevels: 2
:description: Time-harmonic acoustic pressure waves (Helmholtz equation)
:page-math: true

Time-harmonic acoustic pressure waves (Helmholtz equation). Elmer HelmholtzSolver.

[cols="1,3"]
|===
|Category |Acoustics › Pressure Acoustics
|Name (tag) |`+acpr+`
|Space dimensions |3D, 2D, 2D axisymmetric
|Studies |Frequency Domain
|Dependent variables |`+p+` Pressure (real part) (`+Pa+`)
|Default features |<<acpr-pam,Pressure Acoustics>>, <<acpr-init,Initial Values>>, <<acpr-hard,Sound Hard Boundary (Wall)>>
|===

latexmath:[\nabla\cdot\left(-\frac{1}{\rho}\nabla p\right) - \frac{k^2}{\rho}p = 0,\quad k=\frac{\omega}{c}]

Material properties used: Speed of sound (c), Density (ρ).

[#acpr-swr]
=== Spherical Wave Radiation

Outgoing spherical (3D, axisymmetric) or cylindrical (2D) waves from the source location; optionally an incident plane wave p_i = p0 exp(-i k d.x) for scattering (total-field formulation).

Selection: Boundaries · Physics ribbon › Boundaries, or right-click the interface in the Model Builder

latexmath:[-\mathbf{n}\cdot\left(-\frac{1}{\rho}\nabla p\right) + \frac{1}{\rho}\left(ik+\frac{1}{r}\right)p = 0]

[#acpr-efc]
=== Exterior Field Calculation

Kirchhoff-Helmholtz integral over the selected closed surface: the pressure anywhere outside it (acpr.efc1.pext, acpr.efc1.Lp_pext) for grids, radiation patterns and directivity plots.

Selection: Boundaries · Physics ribbon › Boundaries, or right-click the interface in the Model Builder

latexmath:[p_{ext}(\mathbf{x}) = \oint_S \left(p\,\frac{\partial G}{\partial n} - G\,\frac{\partial p}{\partial n}\right) dS,\quad G = \frac{e^{-ikR}}{4\pi R}]

No settings.
